Bodegas Vega Sicilia

Pintia

RedDesignation of Origin (DO) Toro

Toro D.O. red made by the Vega Sicilia group from Tinta de Toro, powerful and barrel-aged.

Pintia is the Vega Sicilia group’s project in the Toro Designation of Origin, with its own winery in the area, and its first released vintage dates from the early 2000s. The name comes from an ancient Vaccaean settlement in the Duero basin.

It is made exclusively from Tinta de Toro, the local adaptation of Tempranillo, from vineyards in the area, many of them old and planted on sandy, stony soils. Toro’s extreme continental climate, with very hot summers, produces thick-skinned grapes with deep colour and great concentration.

The wine is aged in oak barrels and then rests in bottle before release. The winery’s approach seeks to tame Tinta de Toro’s natural power to achieve a concentrated yet balanced red with good ageing potential.

Tasting profile

Very deep cherry-red colour. Aromas of ripe black fruit, liquorice, spice, toasty and mineral notes. Powerful and fleshy on the palate, with abundant but ripe tannins and a long finish.

Food pairing

Chargrilled red meat, game, hearty stews, aged sheep’s cheeses

Serving

16-18 °C, large glass; decanting is advisable
